## About

UFNO Seismic Reconstruction contains the competition and conference workflow for learning a 3D reconstruction operator with U-FNO [@traversa2025ufno]. It trains on patches from open 3D field seismic cubes and considers random, trace-wise, and regular missing-data patterns.

## Why it matters

Acquisition gaps and failed receivers leave missing seismic traces that degrade later processing and interpretation. Operator learning seeks a reusable reconstruction map that generalizes across missing ratios and data resolutions.

## Key result and audience

The project provides data-preparation, training, pretrained-weight, and notebook guidance developed for the CPG-KFUPM machine-learning competition and an EAGE conference paper. It is useful to researchers benchmarking 3D seismic reconstruction and neural operators.
